messages:
deploybot: PRE-DEPLOY WARNING — keystore / service-config mismatch detected for release 2026-03-21T14:00Z.
deploybot: STAGING: EMB_BACKEND_KEY=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/xyz-staging, EMB_S3_PREFIX=s3://redwood-embeddings/staging/
deploybot: PROD:    EMB_BACKEND_KEY=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/xyz-prod, EMB_S3_PREFIX= (missing)
deploybot: Canary at 10% (3/30). Promotion blocked until keystore parity or mitigation applied.
maria_g: ugh, the embedding key rotation yesterday changed the s3 prefix in staging only. that explains failing embed lookups in tests.
chris_l: if prod prefix is missing, runtime falls back to the old blobstore which is rate-limited and will error at ~5rps. high risk for search endpoints.
eng_oncall: agree. last time this happened it caused 502 spikes for search. we should not promote until prod has a valid EMB_S3_PREFIX.
indra_s: product change window is 13:30-14:30UTC today. we're inside it but product wants no keystore writes without legal/ops signoff.
maria_g: options: A) backfill EMB_S3_PREFIX in prod keystore now (small write). B) patch the rollout to use fallback=legacy-s3-prefix for canary only. C) rollback the canary.
chris_l: fallback is messy since prefix naming differs by tenant. would require a mapping table change in runtime — risk of wrong tenant reads.
eng_oncall: backfill is minimal: `/keystore set service-config/EMB_S3_PREFIX s3://redwood-embeddings/prod/` — but we need ops approval and audit entries.
release-eng: ops/legal pinged. ops: can approve small keystore write during change window if scoped and with an audit-runbook. legal: confirm no compliance concern with writing prefix.
release-eng: ops approved with 2FA, but asks to gate with a quick canary-only keystore write first.
maria_g: ok i'll prepare a canary keystore patch then a prod backfill if canary looks fine. plan: 1) write canary-keystore service-config/canary/EMB_S3_PREFIX, 2) route canary pool to read that mapping, 3) monitor for 10m, 4) if green, apply prod keystore backfill.
eng_oncall: monitoring: add alert for embed-404-rate and s3-5xx > 1% for canary. also increase log level for embed-fetcher.
chris_l: create a quick feature-flag to force canary tenants to use the canary prefix; command: `/feature flag set embed_canary_prefix true --scope=canary`
indra_s: release note draft: "Hotfix: backfill embedding S3 prefix in prod to restore embedding lookup parity; canary validated before full promotion."
release-eng: executing canary keystore write now. will post command output.
deploybot: KEYS UPDATE — wrote service-config/canary/EMB_S3_PREFIX -> s3://redwood-embeddings/prod-canary/ (audit id a-918273).
maria_g: patched canary routing to use canary mapping. running synthetic checks now.
eng_oncall: synthetic embed lookup: success 200/200, latency p95 120ms. no s3 5xx observed.
chris_l: thumbs. roll prod backfill once we get legal ack (they're reviewing audit log).
release-eng: legal ack received. executing prod backfill in 5. command: `/keystore set service-config/EMB_S3_PREFIX s3://redwood-embeddings/prod/ --audit=a-918273`
deploybot: KEYS UPDATE — wrote service-config/EMB_S3_PREFIX -> s3://redwood-embeddings/prod/ (audit id a-918274).
eng_oncall: monitoring: no regression in embed lookups, error rate stable. canary promotion unblocked.
maria_g: decision: proceed with promotion. changed canary routing back to default mapping.
release-eng: recorded follow-up ticket REL-4890: reconcile keystore rotation scripts to ensure staging/prod prefix sync and add a preflight rotation checklist. added entry to release notes: "post-release: keystore rotation reconciliation and audit."
chris_l: note for ops: add a linter in rotation job to fail if prefix is only present in staging.
maria_g: thanks all. closing loop. if anything breaks we can `/release rollback 1801004321 --reason="keystore-parity-failure"`.
eng_oncall: closing monitoring after 30m of stability.
release-eng: thread summary: canary blocked by missing prod EMB_S3_PREFIX; Canary-only keystore write validated; prod backfill applied with audit; promotion resumed; follow-up REL-4890 created; customer-facing note updated. :white_check_mark:
